title: fix(update): keep exec SecretRefs cold during private rehearsal
body:
Closes #192066
Reported-by: [mtblackman16](https://github.com/mtblackman16) in #192066.

## What Problem This Solves

Update rehearsal can reject a healthy installation when an exec SecretRef needs credentials that intentionally remain outside disposable scratch state. The private candidate now leaves that capability cold and records an availability warning while validation continues.

## User Impact

An unavailable exec-provider prerequisite during private rehearsal produces a recorded warning rather than a failed update check. The existing snapshot receipt carries that warning into the update run report. Authored SecretRefs remain references; normal Gateway activation still checks credentials against the serving installation. Structural reference errors and explicitly required data/auth owner policies retain their checks.

## Why This Change Was Made

Rehearsal must not execute real secret providers or touch real credentials. Resolving against the real state root would cross that boundary even if intended to be read-only, because arbitrary exec-provider code can read or write there. The shared resolver therefore defers exec dispatch under the complete private-rehearsal contract, and the existing owner-isolation path leaves optional and legacy capability inputs cold. No credential files or resolved values are copied into rehearsal state, and no config option, schema, SDK contract, or protocol is added.

## Evidence

- Final candidate `3f317d88cc4a58df7e972c4758fa39cdf2a0262b` rebases patch-identically onto main `a12e3ae8d85d1f86263054bcd44687b082c710ba`, including budget repair `53a21b7062791c72bf6b2db2adbbb78d7ffae387`. All three commits match the remotely tested patch; secrets, rehearsal/startup/test files and dependency manifests are unchanged. Fresh final autoreview: scoped-clean P0–P2, confidence 0.81.
- **Red on base:** test-only `7e1582e89eb3704c99fb4a39e0cb87e40224bdce` changes only the two regression files and their allocation relative to 9b0. The cold-owner case fails with `SECRET_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`; the real Gateway startup fails because required secrets are unavailable. Malformed-ref control passes. This is actual test execution after an independent frozen install; earlier detached-worktree dependency setup failures are excluded.
- **Green on 60ac:** resolver 2/2, actual Gateway canary 1/1, rehearsal resources 26/26, and `pnpm build:runtime` passed on one granted Crabbox/Testbox lease, [run41726628941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41726628941). The lease was stopped after commands joined, so the enclosing lease workflow concludes cancelled; its successful command results are execution proof, not green PR CI.
- **Production rehearsal:** `validateUpdateCandidateCanary` completed in 17.968 seconds through snapshot, child Doctor, lint/config/plugin/recovery checks, child Gateway startupz/readyz and cleanup. Every step returned 0. The snapshot receipt records unverified credential availability; the ordinary exec positive control works, but rehearsal never creates the resolver marker. Serving token/config bytes remain unchanged, no credential copy or value appears in private state, authored/migrated SecretRefs remain references, and private state is removed.
- **Retained limitation:** the existing resources explicit-tmpdir case first failed under Testbox umask 0002, which makes its nominated parent group-writable. The production owner correctly rejects that parent; umask 077 qualifies the intended private fixture and passes 26/26, without repairing or erasing the earlier source-fixture failure. Doctor lint also recorded one deferred agent inspection (`unavailable-validation-origin`, zero remaining inspection window). Published stable-to-candidate installation/upgrade, a live 1Password account, and a model turn remain follow-ups; this run proves the actual candidate rehearsal with synthetic credentials.
- **CI gate:** the initial [60ac run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41726573920) completed with only inherited main test-line debt (294) and its aggregate failing; our 208-line growth has an exact 208-line grant. Existing owner repair [#192313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192313) landed and is integrated. Final [CI 41731355063](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41731355063) passed on exact head `3f317d88cc4a58df7e972c4758fa39cdf2a0262b`; the full PR rollup is 66 SUCCESS, 62 SKIPPED and 1 NEUTRAL, with no unfinished or failed checks. The old run is not substituted and no inherited-red exception is used.
- `pr-simplify`: existing resolver/owner/receipt machinery, production +32 net lines, docs +8, tests +208. Touched-file lint/format checks from this unchanged patch passed. No timeout increase.
